algorithms.title: SALT Mass Casualty Triage
steps: SORT: 'Walk to [area]' → assess last. 'Wave/move' → assess second. Still/obvious life threat → assess first.
ASSESS each casualty; perform LSIs (seconds): hemorrhage control, open airway (child: consider 2 rescue breaths), chest decompression, auto-injector.
Breathing → Obeys commands/purposeful movement? Peripheral pulse? Not in respiratory distress? Major hemorrhage controlled?
ALL YES → minor injuries only? → MINIMAL; otherwise → DELAYED.
ANY NO → likely to survive with current resources? → IMMEDIATE; otherwise → EXPECTANT (comfort care).
TREATMENT/TRANSPORT in priority order: Immediate → Delayed → Minimal (Expectant when resources allow).

algorithms.title: Re-Triage Loop
steps: Secondary triage at treatment area entry (more detailed physiology, injury, age).
Re-check while waiting (assign a medic per area, every ~15 min or per protocol).
Pre-transport triage to set loading order and destination.
Any change: re-tag, note time, tell the Treatment and Transport Officers.
